raw.cause: While handling MSG_POSITION from nav, gps_handle() (COCKPIT_FAULT=deadlock) does its own MsgSend() to cockpit-nav for a MSG_HINT before replying. nav's only thread is REPLY-blocked in MsgSend() to gps inside nav_handle(), so it can never MsgReceive() the hint. gps stays SEND-blocked on nav and nav stays REPLY-blocked on gps. display, which sends to nav, is stuck behind them. The send also breaks the contract, which allows only nav -> gps and has no gps -> nav edge.
raw.qnx_call: MsgSend in gps (gps_handle sends MSG_HINT to nav while nav is REPLY-blocked on gps)
raw.fix_summary: Remove the gps -> nav call. The contract makes gps a leaf server that only replies, so gps must answer MSG_POSITION from its own state. If gps really needs routing context, nav should put it in the MSG_POSITION request, or gps should get it from a pulse that nav sends asynchronously. gps must never MsgSend() upstream. Keep the blueprint as is: it already forbids gps -> nav.
